name: ai-realtime-canvas
description: Real-time collaborative canvas: prompt -> structured JSON -> draggable Konva shapes synced over Socket.io

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @canvas/backend && npm run build -w @canvas/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @canvas/shared && npm run test -w @canvas/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @canvas/shared && npm run typecheck -w @canvas/backend && npm run typecheck -w @canvas/frontend
